Comment by niels9001: ## Tracking: Generic Install/Update Failures This issue is being kept as the tracking issue for generic PowerToys installation and update failures. The following related issues have been closed as duplicates pointing here: ### Consolidated error reports: - **#32466** — Auto-update fails with a generic error (v0.79, auto-update method) - **#32586** — MS Store update fails with "An error occurred trying to install this update" (v0.80.1, MS Store) - **#36468** — Cannot install v0.87.1 — says previous version must be uninstalled first, even after manual removal with Iobit Uninstaller (GitHub installer, admin) - **#38464** — MS Store install fails for 6+ months with "We couldn't complete the installation. Wait a bit, then try again" (MS Store) - **#41884** — Auto-update hangs on setup screen during v0.94.1 update (auto-update method) - **#42024** — Cannot install, update, or uninstall — two versions appear installed simultaneously, all methods fail (multiple methods tried) ### Common patterns: - Failures span all install methods: GitHub .exe, MS Store, auto-update, winget - Some users have orphaned/corrupt previous installs blocking new ones - Error messages are often vague ("Setup Failed", generic error dialogs) - Several users report the issue persisting across multiple PT versions > For **Start Menu shortcut failures** see #16490 | **Disk space errors** see #26570 | **DLL/corruption errors** see #35949
